headline: Brazil Reports $1.69 Billion Weekly Trade Surplus on Strong Export Volume
summary: Brazil recorded a trade surplus of $1.69 billion in the fourth week of October, supported by a 27.9% year-over-year surge in export values.
why: Foreign trade balances are a vital measure of dollar inflows and economic stability for Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Strong export growth expands foreign reserves and strengthens the trade balance.
